game_title: Signal Logic – Coral Reef Shallows Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round, smugglers strike the ship's hull, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safety value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ship's hull from smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows: keep the safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
